question: Who appointed the ‘Hunter Commission’ for Educational Reforms in 1882?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lord Ripon**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Hunter Commission was appointed in **1882** by **Lord Ripon**, the then Viceroy of India.
 
• The commission was tasked with evaluating the state of education in India and recommending reforms to improve access to education.
 
• It placed strong emphasis on the expansion of primary education, especially among rural communities and underprivileged sections.
 
• It advocated for the involvement of local self-governments to fund and manage primary education institutions.
 
• The commission also recommended the establishment of secondary schools to cater to the growing demand for higher education.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lord Ripon:**

 
 
• Lord Ripon served as the Viceroy of India from **1880 to 1884**.
 
• He is known as the **Father of Local Self-Government in India** for his efforts in decentralizing administrative powers.
 
• Ripon implemented several reforms in education, local governance, and civil liberties.
 
 
 
• **Primary Education in Colonial India:**
 
 
• During the 19th century, education in India was limited to elite groups, while rural and underprivileged communities had minimal access.
 
• The Hunter Commission sought to address these disparities by promoting universal access to primary education.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the Hunter Commission:**
 
 
• It marked a pivotal step in formalizing education policies in British India.
 
• The recommendations laid the groundwork for further education reforms in the 20th century.
 
 
 
• **Local Self-Government:**
 
 
• Ripon encouraged local self-governments to take responsibility for funding and managing schools.
 
• This approach empowered local bodies and improved accountability in education delivery.
